card.name: Words leading into accidental contact instructions
card.fires_on: Linking words in conditional clauses just before a verb of contact with skin, eyes or mucosa, such as 'If the solution <<should>> come into contact' or 'In <<case>> of eye contact'.

modes.label: If drug contacts skin or mucosa
modes.description: The drug name or a linking word inside an 'If X contacts/comes into contact with the skin' clause.
modes.example: If irinotecan hydrochloride<< injection>> contacts the mucous membranes, flush thoroughly

modes.label: In case of eye contact
modes.description: The words 'case' or 'of' in 'In case of eye or accidental contact' warnings.
modes.example: In<< case>> of accidental contact, rinse well with water

card.writes: The promoted tokens mean 'fall' or 'drop onto' (including Chinese 落, 掉), suggesting an expected verb of something landing or touching.
card.plain: It fires in warnings that say what to do if the product gets on the skin or in the eyes, right before the word for contact.
